Promptr Studio Pro 5.102

New model

  • FLUX 3 by Black Forest Labs. Text to image with up to ten reference images, in 1K, 2K or 4K and any format from 21:9 to 9:21, or Auto.

Editing apps

  • Premiere Pro panel. Generate images and videos right inside Premiere Pro 26.3 or later. Add the frame at the playhead, an In/Out range or a file as a reference, and the result lands in a Promptr bin. Install it under Settings.
  • New DaVinci Resolve panel. Resolve gets the same compact panel. Chatting with Paul stays in the app. Update the panel under Settings.

Paul

  • Works more on his own. With nothing selected in the gallery, Paul uses the newest image of the conversation. Characters you mention by name come along as references.
  • Finds another way. When a generation fails, Paul looks at the reason and suggests a different route. You approve it as usual.
  • Sharper thinking. Paul now runs on GPT-6.1 Sol.

Fixes

  • A sign-in check that briefly fails on the server no longer ends a generation with "Session expired". The app tries once more by itself.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.101

3D Scene Composer

  • Step by step. A step bar guides you from building the scene to camera, motion and export.
  • All models at hand. Every element sits in the sidebar, grouped and ready to drag into the scene. GLB files can be dropped in from the Finder.
  • Floating controls. A panel over the image shows the tools and shortcuts of each step.
  • Camera moves. Push in, pull back, orbit, crane and more, aimed at the subject you choose.
  • Save as MP4. Export the scene as a video file.

Workflow

  • Move projects. Right-click a project in the sidebar to move its folder, for example into your client's folder.
  • Done marks on folders. A folder shows a green check when a generation in it is done and a red mark when one failed, until you open it.
  • Before and after for every upscale. Topaz and Crystal upscales get the comparison slider, like Magnific.
  • Clearer start. The tour and the New Project dialog explain credits, cloud and folders in plain words.
  • Paul in your language. Paul's tool messages and approvals follow the app language.
  • Usage list. Every entry says what it was, AI calls included.
  • Smart Edit on small screens. The Smart Edit bar fits narrow columns, for example on a laptop with the agent open.

Fixes

  • GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, Flare and Sunburst Edit are ready to generate right after the app starts.
  • No "Price unknown" on the Generate button before you write a prompt.
  • Expand after a running Replace no longer sends a second Replace.
  • "Editing…" no longer stays on screen when an edit is declined.
  • The selection bar shows icons instead of cut-off labels in a narrow gallery.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.100

Ideogram 4.5

  • Ideogram 4.5. A new image model for posters, logos and designs with accurate text. Choose 1K or 2K, both at the same price.
  • Ideogram 4.5 Edit. Edit with a prompt and up to four references. With each edit, image models can introduce pixel shifts, color changes, and texture artifacts. Ideogram 4.5 reduces this drift, preserving details across multi-turn edits.
  • Precise mode. Edit high-resolution images without downsizing them. Ideogram 4.5 preserves the edges of an edited crop, so you can stitch it seamlessly back into the original. Create new colorways or fix a detail while keeping the rest of your image sharp and untouched, ready for close-ups and large-format print.
  • Better inpainting. Replace and Expand in the brush tool now run on Ideogram 4.5 and understand instructions like "change this to a red mug".
